checks.text: With no input, the page shows the heading "Barcode Generator", a select labelled "Barcode type" with options "Code 128", "EAN-13", and "QR Code", a text field labelled "Data", and a button "Generate".

Typing "HELLO" in the field labelled "Data", selecting "Code 128" in the select labelled "Barcode type", and clicking "Generate" shows a preview area containing a barcode image and the text "Code 128: HELLO".

Typing "123456789012" in the field labelled "Data", selecting "EAN-13" in the select labelled "Barcode type", and clicking "Generate" shows a preview area containing a barcode image and the text "EAN-13: 1234567890123" where the last digit is the computed check digit.

Typing "1234567890123" in the field labelled "Data", selecting "EAN-13" in the select labelled "Barcode type", and clicking "Generate" shows the message "EAN-13 requires exactly 12 digits" and no barcode image.

Typing "Hello World" in the field labelled "Data", selecting "QR Code" in the select labelled "Barcode type", and clicking "Generate" shows a preview area containing a QR code image and the text "QR Code: Hello World".
After generating a Code 128 barcode for "HELLO", clicking the button "Download PNG" triggers a file download with a filename ending in ".png".
Typing an empty string in the field labelled "Data" and clicking "Generate" shows the message "Enter data to generate a barcode" and no barcode image.
After generating a Code 128 barcode for "HELLO", reloading the page still shows the text "Code 128: HELLO" in the preview area.
